zh.title: 发布状态
items: **0.1.0-rc.21** 继续修复大历史项目执行时的全局间歇停顿。正式版仍为 0.0.18。
RC20 公开构建的完整真实任务功能通过，但主进程单次停顿超过验收门槛；本版保留该失败记录并继续修复，不将 RC20 记为完整性能通过。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: 计划发现按既有持久变更日志增量失效，避免恢复、核验和调度反复逐一检查全部历史计划文件。日志异常时重新完整校验，每个已知任务仍读取当前计划和执行守卫。
临时任务的工具结果现在跟随指定数据根保存，避免测试或多环境运行的新材料写入日常用户缓存。旧记录和产物引用不迁移、不重写。
同步中英文更新说明与站点日志；保留真实大历史任务、独立核验、正式回复、取消及大记录提交的验收范围。

zh.title: 升级与验收范围
items: 数据格式与权限链保持。升级前备份完整数据根，Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway 同步升级；正式版通道不变。
私有历史仅用于本地无凭据离线复现；真实模型任务使用生成历史，不上传个人记录。先前测试生成的少量工具缓存已按明确身份核对迁回对应隔离目录，并保留文件校验记录。
性能验收不代表所有机器零峰值；产品截图由实施者自审，完整读屏、Windows/Linux 交互安装和长期日用不在本轮断言内。

en.title: Release status
items: **0.1.0-rc.21** continues to address intermittent application-wide stalls during large-history task execution. Stable remains 0.0.18.
The public RC20 build passed the complete real task workflow but exceeded the main-process latency gate. That failure is retained and is not described as a complete performance pass.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Incrementally invalidate plan discovery using the existing durable change journal instead of repeatedly inspecting every historical plan during recovery, verification and scheduling. Invalid observations trigger a full recheck; known tasks still read current plans and execution guards.

Materialize tool results under the selected data root so temporary tasks and separate environments do not write new artifacts into the daily user cache. Existing records and artifact references are not migrated or rewritten.
Synchronize bilingual release notes and the documentation changelog, retaining full-scale real-task, independent verification, delivery, cancellation and large-record acceptance scenarios.

en.title: Upgrade and validation scope
items: Retain data formats and permission boundaries. Back up the complete data root and upgrade Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. The stable channel is unchanged.

Personal history is used only for local credential-free offline reproduction. Real-model tasks use generated history without uploading personal records. A small set of earlier generated test artifacts was identity-checked and moved back to its isolated directories with file-integrity records retained.

Performance checks do not imply zero spikes on every machine. Product screenshots receive implementer self-review. Full screen-reader coverage, interactive Windows/Linux installation and long-term use remain outside this claim.
